position: Union Transparency; Office of Labor-Management Standards Initiative
proposal: The Mandate recommends that DOL restore the T-1 trust annual report filing requirement, bring the substance of the Intermediate Bodies rule (government unions filing like private unions) into effect by rulemaking or legislation, and that Congress increase funding for the Office of Labor-Management Standards. It also asks OLMS to revise its standards so it can investigate unions without a formal complaint.

status_summary: DOL published a final rule on 2026-06-01, effective 2026-07-01 for labor organizations whose fiscal years begin on or after that date, adding a Form LM-2 Long Form for the largest unions, revising the LM-2 and LM-3, and adjusting filing thresholds. The text discusses an LM-2 item asking whether a union has a trust, but it does not restore the T-1 trust report or address intermediate bodies or public-sector unions, and no Federal Register document restoring either was found. Funding and investigation-standard changes were not found.

timeline.event: DOL published a final rule revising the Form LM-2 and LM-3 annual financial reports and filing thresholds, effective 2026-07-01 for fiscal years beginning on or after that date.
